column12: Effects
Wearing casual clothing allows you to re-roll a single d20 on one STR or AGI based skill test you make each scene, as the clothing is easy to move in.
Wearing military fatigues allows you to re-roll a single d20 on one STR or AGI based skill test you make each scene, as the fatigues are easy to move in.

Wearing a heavy coat allows you to re-roll a single d20 on one END-based skill test you make each scene, as it helps protect you from harsh conditions.
Between the utility of the design, and simply feeling smarter while wearing one, a lab coat allows you to re-roll a single d20 on one INT based skill test you make each scene.
Utility Coveralls increase the wearer's maximum carry weight by +5.
A character wearing a casual hat ignores any difficulty increases caused by extremely bright light.
